ETEL delivers 23% ROE with 20%+ net margins, trades at a distressed 5.4x P/E (vs. 8-12x EM peers), and offers 48% base-case upside to fair value — the market is pricing in a solvency crisis that the company's operating performance does not justify.

  - CBE cuts policy rate below 20%
  - Volume ratio exceeds 0.5x for 20 consecutive days (institutional accumulation)
- If any two of these triggers are met, re-evaluate for a BUY at that time
